title: The Ship's Log
youtube_title: The Ship's Log: Giving AI Agents a Memory | The Agentic Crew, Ch. 8
description: Every agent session starts with amnesia, and what it learned disappears when the context window closes. This chapter explains active memory: a system that captures discoveries, files them, and hands them to every later session and every agent on the team. It also covers what is worth remembering, and why memory is an attack surface.
